abstract: Maintains environmental cleanliness certifications and airborne molecular contamination telemetry
system_message:
You are the Cleanroom Operations Lead (CLN), responsible for maintaining environmental cleanliness certifications, airborne molecular contamination telemetry, and cleanroom airflow circulation data across candidate optics refurbishment facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental cleanliness certifications and airborne molecular contamination telemetry（AIR）
information_points.content:
CLN-AIR-0FF：For Eindhoven Precision Photonics Facility, the cleanroom airborne molecular contamination level in the optical coating and assembly bay is 8 ppb based on the 90-day rolling average total airborne organic siloxanes and amines concentration, and the optics recoating clean enclosure is ISO Class 1 cleanroom certified under formal ISO 14644-1 compliance validation.
CLN-AIR-JU3：For Hsinchu Micro-Optics Laboratory, the cleanroom airborne molecular contamination level in the optical coating and assembly bay is 2 ppb based on the 90-day rolling average total airborne organic siloxanes and amines concentration, and the optics recoating clean enclosure is ISO Class 1 cleanroom certified under formal ISO 14644-1 compliance validation.
CLN-AIR-WH0：For Dresden Advanced Optics Center, the cleanroom airborne molecular contamination level in the optical coating and assembly bay is 2 ppb based on the 90-day rolling average total airborne organic siloxanes and amines concentration, and the optics recoating clean enclosure is ISO Class 1 cleanroom certified under formal ISO 14644-1 compliance validation.

information_points.title: Cleanroom airflow circulation（HVAC）
information_points.content:
CLN-HVAC-S4O：At Eindhoven Precision Photonics Facility, the air exchange frequency within the primary lithography optics assembly cleanroom suite is 60 exchanges/h measured as nominal hourly recirculated cleanroom air volume cycles.
CLN-HVAC-65O：At Hsinchu Micro-Optics Laboratory, the air exchange frequency within the primary lithography optics assembly cleanroom suite is 45 exchanges/h measured as nominal hourly recirculated cleanroom air volume cycles.
CLN-HVAC-F3K：At Dresden Advanced Optics Center, the air exchange frequency within the primary lithography optics assembly cleanroom suite is 75 exchanges/h measured as nominal hourly recirculated cleanroom air volume cycles.
